seasonal_signals.title: Leavenworth County Veterans Day Parade
seasonal_signals.description: Oldest and largest Veterans Day observance west of the Mississippi River. Military bands, active units, and vintage armor.
seasonal_signals.paired_stitch: Stop at First City Creative for hot cocoa and craft sodas after the parade.

seasonal_signals.title: Mayor's Holiday Tree Lighting & Stroll
seasonal_signals.description: Downtown lighting ceremony at Haymarket Square with live brass, carolers, hot cider, and Santa arrival.
seasonal_signals.paired_stitch: Walk Delaware St to see historic window displays and grab fresh dinner.

seasonal_signals.title: Fort Leavenworth MWR Family Turkey Trot 5K
seasonal_signals.description: Family-paced 5K run and stroller walk through the historic brick quarters of the post.
seasonal_signals.paired_stitch: Head to Strike Zone bowling for cosmic lanes and hot lunch.

seasonal_signals.title: Corridor Wildlife Alert: Peak Deer Rut Movement
seasonal_signals.description: Heavy buck movement across Highway 192, Millwood Rd, and US-73 at dawn and dusk. Stay vigilant around timber creek crossings.
seasonal_signals.paired_stitch: Plan evening drives on primary routes; slow speeds around Stranger Creek.
